demoData.title: Demonstration data only
demoData.body: This environment uses fabricated, non-production data. All signers, payments, and credentials are fictional and safe to share. Do not enter real personal or banking information.

nonBinding.title: No real payments are initiated
nonBinding.body: Actions taken here are simulated. No funds move, no messages are sent to any provider, and no real signatures are collected.

credentialHint.title: Demo credentials are not secrets
credentialHint.body: The credential hints shown below are shared demo logins for exploring each role. They carry no real access and must never be reused for production systems.

credentialHintLabels.sectionDescription: Choose a role to explore its capabilities. Every credential below is a shared, non-production demo login.

signIn.title: Signed in
signIn.body: You are signed in with the selected demo role. Your session will time out automatically after a period of inactivity.

signOut.title: Signed out
signOut.body: Your demo session has ended and any in-memory state has been cleared.

invalidCredentials.title: Sign-in failed
invalidCredentials.body: The username or passcode did not match a known demo account. Pick a role from the credential hints and try again.

sessionExpired.title: Session expired
sessionExpired.body: Your demo session timed out due to inactivity. Sign in again to continue.

unauthorized.title: Access denied
unauthorized.body: Your current role does not hold the capability required for this action. Switch to a role that grants it and try again.

sessionWarning.title: Session about to expire
sessionWarning.body: You will be signed out soon because of inactivity. Interact with the page to stay signed in.

resendLimit.title: Resend limit reached
resendLimit.body: You have used all available resend attempts within the last 24 hours. This limit is enforced client-side for the demo only and is not a server guarantee.

resendAvailable.title: Resend available
resendAvailable.body: You can resend this invitation. A limited number of resends are allowed within a rolling 24-hour window in this demo.

signerLocked.title: Signer is locked
signerLocked.body: This signer record is locked due to a concurrent edit and cannot be modified right now. Locking is simulated for the demo and is not a server-enforced constraint.

signerInactive.title: Signer is not active
signerInactive.body: Only active signers may be actioned. Suspended, revoked, or pending signers must first be returned to an active status.

invitationExpired.title: Invitation expired
invitationExpired.body: This invitation lapsed before it was accepted. Resend a fresh invitation to re-enroll the signer.

invitationSent.title: Invitation sent
invitationSent.body: A simulated invitation has been issued to the signer. In this demo, no message actually leaves the app.

invitationResent.title: Invitation resent
invitationResent.body: A fresh simulated invitation has been issued. Your remaining resend attempts for this rolling 24-hour window have been reduced.

entitlementUpdated.title: Signer updated
entitlementUpdated.body: The signer entitlement changes have been recorded in this demo session.

concurrentEdit.title: Changes could not be saved
concurrentEdit.body: This signer was updated elsewhere while you were editing. Reload the latest details and reapply your changes.

readOnlyField.title: Field is read-only
readOnlyField.body: One or more fields you attempted to change are locked for this signer and cannot be edited in its current state.

notFound.title: Signer not found
notFound.body: The requested signer record could not be located. It may have been removed from this demo session.

maskedForPrivacy.title: Some details are masked
maskedForPrivacy.body: Contact and identifier fields are masked according to the active display policy to protect personal information.

readOnly.title: Audit trail is read-only
readOnly.body: Audit events are append-only and cannot be edited or deleted. Entries reflect simulated activity in this demo session.

empty.title: No audit events yet
empty.body: There is no recorded activity to display. Actions taken in this demo will appear here as sanitized audit entries.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.body: An unexpected error interrupted this action. No changes were saved — please try again.

storageUnavailable.title: Storage unavailable
storageUnavailable.body: Browser storage is disabled or full, so this demo is running from temporary in-memory data. Your changes will not persist across reloads.

loading.title: Loading
loading.body: Please wait while the requested information is prepared.
